quote: 16 May 2025 – LONGi … has partnered with global energy leader Yinson Renewables to supply 53.2MW of Hi-MO 9 modules for the Sol de Verano 1 Solar Project, near Majes in Peru. … The Sol de Verano 1 project … will deploy 82,836 Hi-MO 9 high efficiency modules … Construction is set to begin in May 2025
note: Opened LONGi English release 16 May 2025 (Sol de Verano 1 / 53.2 MW Hi-MO 9).
